summary: Focused re-test of the 4 fixes from this iteration: (1) EchoHeading no longer triple-repeats; (2) descender clipping resolved on gradient headings; (3) Accueil added to sticky nav; (4) 12 realisations + enriched À propos. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (health, realisations count=12, all 6 new ids present, sectors include Contrôle/Maintenance/Sécurité, devis validation). Frontend: verified sticky nav order [Accueil, Solutions, Réalisations, À propos, Contact] with correct data-testids and nav-accueil highlighted only on '/'; Home hero renders EchoHeading only once ('votre partenaire de confiance.' appears exactly 1x); descenders (ç, é, y, g, q) visible without clipping in gradient hero (verified via screenshots on '/', '/realisations', '/a-propos'); all Home sections + CTAs present; Réalisations shows 12 cards including 6 new ids, filter buttons include Contrôle/Maintenance/Sécurité and filter-Contrôle correctly reduces the set to 1 card; About page has all 6 requested sections (about-hero, about-stats with 4 KPIs 500+/15 MW/12/10 ans, about-expertises with 4 cards, about-valeurs with 3 cards, about-habilitations with all 7 items, about-certifications) plus about-cta; Contact form submits to success screen (frontend call mocked to respect 1-email cap); Floating actions open WhatsApp (wa.me) and phone (tel:) with correct hrefs. Exactly 1 real devis email sent during this run (from the backend pytest test_devis_valid_payload_returns_success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/realisations now returns exactly 12 items with all new ids and expected sectors (Contrôle, Maintenance, Sécurité). Clean, still <300 lines, async Mongo, UUID id, EmailStr validation, safe HTML escape. Good.

Header.jsx: NAV array correctly starts with { to: '/', label: 'Accueil' }; NavLink uses end={n.to === '/'} so nav-accueil is exact-match only. data-testids follow pattern nav-accueil / nav-<slug>. Same testids exist for the mobile menu (nav-mobile-*). Good.

EchoHeading.jsx: simplified to 1 before + 1 echo (no repeat). lineHeight 1.1 and pb-1 on each line prevent descender clipping. Verified visually — 'ç' in 'confiance.', 'é' in 'énergétique.' and 'g/q' descenders are fully visible.
MaskedLines.jsx / index.css .prism-gradient-text: line-height 1.1–1.15 + pb-1 / padding-bottom 0.08em applied consistently. Good.
About.jsx: 6 distinct sections with data-testids, all 4 KPI stats, 4 expertise cards, 3 valeurs cards, 7 habilitations items exactly as spec. about-cta at bottom still routes to /contact.

Realisations.jsx: card testids follow pattern 'realisation-<id>' (not 'realisation-card-<id>'). Filter buttons use 'filter-<Sector>' where sector contains diacritics (e.g. filter-Contrôle, filter-Sécurité). No unresolvable issues — just noting selector shape for next agent.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_-prefixed devis document inserted in Mongo `devis` collection by backend pytest (respecting the 1-email cap). UUID-tagged, safe to prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Realisation card selector is 'realisation-<id>' (no 'card' word). Filter selector is 'filter-<Sector>' with original diacritics preserved (Contrôle, Sécurité). Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py sends exactly 1 real devis email per run — mock /api/devis on the frontend to avoid extra sends. Nav: use data-testid='nav-accueil' (not 'nav-') and end={to==='/'} means accueil is active only on '/'. All 4 fixes from this iteration are verified — no follow-up work required.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Prior 'text duplicated' report is confirmed resolved: EchoHeading now renders exactly 1 gradient echo, and the descender clipping (ç/é/y) is fixed via lineHeight+padding on both EchoHeading and prism-gradient-text.
